candidates.yourNature_desc: You are the mountain the old maps warn rivers about. Everything heavy finds you, the way water finds low ground, and you take it on without ever posting a limit. Nothing moves you visibly. The people leaning hardest stopped asking how you're doing, mostly because you've never once answered. The snow on your shoulders has years in it. You call the arrangement fair.

self_card.presence: Weight finds you the way water finds low ground. You can carry what arrives, and you do. Setting something down still feels like a foreign language.
